notes:
Prospect overview: Verdigris Insightworks builds a knowledge layer for mid-market product teams (customer-facing help + in-app guidance). Evaluated Redwood Hosted API in Jan-Feb POC; strong performance for embeddings and doc-search. After positive POC results they requested Dedicated for predictable throughput, VPC tenancy and stronger contractual commitments.

Timeline / activity log (bulleted):
- 2025-11-12: Initial inbound (trial sign-up) — discovered mid-market product team use-case.
- 2025-12-04: Demo with AE (Maya) + SE (Oliver). Focus: embeddings pipeline and reranking latency.
- 2026-01-08: Hosted API POC kicked off: 2-week test, 500k tokens, metric collection.
- 2026-01-28: POC review (Fireflies ff_20260128_demo_verdigris) — VP Product: "need predictable SLOs before we can commit to product rollout".
- 2026-02-11: Pricing & capacity call — discussed Dedicated sizing, reserved GPU pools, burst options (ff_20260211_pricing_call).
- 2026-02-18: Internal budget signaled (finance) — green light to proceed to procurement if legal ok.
- 2026-03-02: Redwood sent standard MSA + DPA + SLA addendum. Verdigris legal returned redlines (gmail.thread.19b8c4.legal-redlines).
- 2026-03-08: AE + SE call to triage redlines; clarified technical controls for KMS and audit logs.

POC highlights & metrics:
- Embeddings recall improved search relevance by ~23% vs baseline.
- Average token latency on Hosted POC: 75ms with occasional spikes up to 210ms under bursty loads.
- Target for Dedicated: 95th percentile latency <120ms and sustained throughput 50 req/s for reranking path.

Requirements summary (customer stated):
- Deployment: VPC-attached Dedicated cluster, isolated network egress, support for private model variants.
- SLO/SLA: 99.9% availability, 95th latency <120ms for production reranking routes, error budget terms spelled out in SLA.
- Security & Compliance: SOC2 attestation, SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS/HSM, audit logs retention 12 months, data residency in US only.
- Legal: DPA with subprocessor list (must include cloud infra ops), retention & deletion language tightened, IP indemnity carveouts requested (no assignment of customer data).
- Onboarding: 4-week vendor onboarding and migration window, Redwood to provide runbook & week-1 performance tuning session.

Pricing / commercial notes:
- Proposed Dedicated commit: 8 reserved GPUs, monthly commit with burstable capacity. Approx ARR band discussed 150k-350k depending on commit length (12 vs 24 months).
- Customer pushed back on early termination fees; asked for prorated refunds for unused commit in year 2.

Legal & procurement status:
- Verdigris legal redlined MSA heavily around indemnity, IP, and limitation clauses. Also asked for SOC2 report and KBA on key management.
- Redwood legal returned comments 2026-03-09; differences remain on indemnity subparagraph and DPA retention periods.
- Procurement requires final signed MSA + PO before Dedicated provisioning. CFO review expected 2026-03-18.

Operational / technical notes:
- SE (Oliver) to provide SAML metadata and test SSO staging by 2026-03-15.
- Security wants end-to-end diagram and list of sub-processors; drive link shared: https://drive.google.com/drive/verdigris/security-faq.pdf.
- Proposed onboarding plan: week 0: legal/contract sign-off; week 1: network setup & SSO; week 2: baseline traffic migration & smoke tests; week 3: performance tuning & caching config; week 4: SLA handover.

Direct quotes from stakeholders:
- VP Product (Anika Shah): "If we can't get a clear, contractual latency SLO and straightforward audit logs, we can't go live."
- CTO (Marcus Lee): "Need to see KMS key wrap options and a subprocessor list before we escalate to procurement."

Open action items (short):
- Redwood legal: finalize response to MSA/DPA redlines by 2026-03-20.
- SE (Oliver): deliver SAML metadata + test SSO staging by 2026-03-15.
- AE (Maya): coordinate procurement PO and CFO review; confirm forecast month 2026-04.
- Devops: prepare dedicated cluster provisioning checklist; pre-approve IP allowlist.

Notes on risk & recommendation:
- Risk: sticking points in indemnity & retention could delay close 2-4 weeks.
- Recommendation: offer a narrow indemnity carveout and explicit data residency guarantee to accelerate procurement; provide temp SLA credits in early months as a compromise.
